blocks.html: Statistics does not begin with a formula. It begins with a recorded observation: a datum (plural data) is any recorded value describing a defined unit under study. This chapter covers what must be settled before any arithmetic: what a variable is and how it is measured (§1.1), whom the data describe (§1.2–1.3), how a raw list becomes a table (§1.4), where Indian health data come from (§1.4.4), which study design produced them (§1.5), and how they are coded, entered and cleaned in software (§1.6, which ends with an optional R primer).
